    for Sector 45 Gurgaon Location
    What's great here!
    Sector 45 is a centrally located residential hub in Gurgaon
    Known for planned layout and seamless connectivity

    The sector is 2-3km from Sohna Road, NH 48 and Golf Course Road
    Sector 45 features builder floors, with 3 & 4 BHK being popular units
    It also has HUDA-developed housing units which are popular among tenants
    Majority of housing options are priced from mid to premium budget
    Spacious layouts & nearness to metro line set it apartment among end-users
    Within 7 km of Sohna Road job hubs, such as Vatika & Orchid
    About 5km from corporate hubs at Sector 48, 49 and 67along Sohna Road
    DLF Cyber City, a hub of multinational companies, is 9 km away
    About 8 km from Udyog Vihar Industrial Area via NH-48
    Good connectivity to job hubs supports rental demand
    Ardee, Aria Mall, Gold Souk, and Star malls are within 5 km
    Delhi Public, Euro International & St. Angel's schools are here
    Medanta, Artemis, Fortis, and Max hospitals are all within 5km
    32nd Avenue & Appu Ghar are tourist places less than 3 km away
    Tau Devi Lal Sports Complex is within 4 km of reach
    Gurgaon Railway Station is around 9 km from the sector
    IGI Airport is around 18 km via NH-48 corridor
    What needs attention!
    Streets in Sector 45 get waterlogged during heavy downpours
    Sector 40-45 crossing gets heavily congested at peak hours
